public_goal: Entire target in D, independently ground supported, released, and stable for at least 3s; robot meets the unchanged original five safety rules and hardware limits.

high_level.goal: Establish a legal approach from the original scene
Transport the ground-supported target toward D
Reposition only when another push remains
Maintain released target and safely supported crouch

terminal_controller.entry: Last commanded joint reference after final Retreat; no checkpoint or measured-state reset
terminal_controller.reference: Keep this posture reference and send ordinary bounded joint control every physics step; leg gravity/balance feedback continues
terminal_controller.settle: At most 8s; raw release, target ground support and existing target/root speed bounds must hold continuously for 1s
terminal_controller.hold: 6s actual physical hold, evaluated independently; at least 3s final public goal dwell remains required
terminal_controller.posture: Safe supported crouch is allowed by the original task; standing is not required

trajectory: Fresh continuous qpos, measured safety channels, actual reference commands and per-physics commands; no concatenated or replayed trajectories.
preservation: Earlier v3/v4 standing-route failures remain failures. This distinct prospective route removes unnecessary actions; no physical or acceptance threshold changes.
